name: Chuoi ngu
summary: Chuối ngự is a small banana on the Nam Định gift list. Dân Việt on 16 April 2014 says the fruit is small, yellow like silk, fragrant, and lightly sweet, and that the king granted the name. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 describes chuối Ngự Đại Hoàng at Hòa Hậu and Tiến Thắng, Lý Nhân, and prints both tỉnh Hải Nam and tỉnh Hà Nam. Those are different places. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 list chuối ngự as a Nam Định gift and do not name a village. Dân Việt on 16 April 2014 says Nam Định and does not name a village. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 says Đại Hoàng, xã Hòa Hậu, huyện Lý Nhân, and also writes tỉnh Hải Nam in one sentence and tỉnh Hà Nam in the next. All stay.
texture: On 16 April 2014 the fruit is very small, ripe to a silk yellow, fragrant, and lightly sweet. On 15 April 2025 the Đại Hoàng fruit is small, thin-skinned, bright yellow, round, without ridges, yellow and firm inside, and not mushy. The same article says some people count three kinds, ngự trắng, ngự trâu, and ngự mít, and that people in Đại Hoàng say they grow only one, which they call Ngự vàng. Both counts stay.
howToEat: As fruit, and as a gift. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 says Đại Hoàng fruit is used for offerings and for Tết. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The city gift list names no village. Đại Hoàng is Hòa Hậu and Tiến Thắng in Lý Nhân, printed once as Hải Nam and once as Hà Nam. Do not treat one address as the only one.
seoTitle: Chuoi ngu — two places, both printed
seoDescription: A small banana on the Nam Định gift list, and chuối Ngự Đại Hoàng in Lý Nhân. Hải Nam and Hà Nam are both printed. A price is Check on arrival.
